name: Ring of Disharmony
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ornate ring looks like a ring of inspired performance. Rather than impart a bonus, however, the wearer suffers a -5 penalty to his Perform checks.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse, followed by casting shatter, upon it, destroying the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of inspired performance

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
